integrity: The unrestricted formulas follow from an explicit combinatorial first-move classification, valid forcing schedules, and an exact real-symmetric Gram matrix; the finite verification program corroborates only its enumerated parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary third powers of trees with \(t\ge2\) pendant leaves at the root of one handle of length \(\ell\ge2\). Does not establish enumeration for arbitrary spiders or other graph powers. No independent mathematical validation has been performed. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Minimum zero forcing sets and maximum nullity of cubed broom trees
